entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet publish on file-based Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web app recursively nests artifacts #65813
  • [aw] No-Op Runs #65812
  • Benchmark stopped running: blazorwasmbenchmark #65811
  • Perf regression: httpsys-hostheader-mismatch #65810
  • Perf improvement: kestrel-header-symbols #65809
  • OpenAPI document generation uses wrong XML comments #65805
  • Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server does not allow explicit file name with dots #65802
  • Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server does not respect OpenAPI version set in code #65801

Closed

  • Benchmark stopped running: blazorwasmbenchmark #65789
  • Consolidate `HttpsConnectionAdapterOptions` and `TlsHandshakeCallbackOptions` #65607
    .NET 11 Planning
  • The Entity Framework migrations failed in the 11.0 preview 3 project with error "Your startup project doesn't reference Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design.“ #65750

PullRequests

Created

  • Include exception in ProblemDetailsContext for controller error responses #65817
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Treat empty query strings as null for nullable value types #65816
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Add Name parameter to UserPasskeyInfo constructor #65815
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • [WIP] rework `TlsClientHelloBytesCallback` as a connection middleware #65808
    area-networking
  • [WIP] feat: add `HandshakeException` on `ITlsHandshakeFeature` #65807
    area-networking
  • Surface primary constructor parameter attributes in OpenAPI schemas #65804
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • Respect AllowRefresh in SecurityStampValidator cookie renewal #65803
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #65799
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:

Merged

  • Fix 10.0 milestone #65818
    needs-area-label, 11.0-preview3
  • [release/10.0] Restore trimming test projects serially #65798
    area-infrastructure, tell-mode, 10.0.6
  • Fix .devcontainer references to archived repo #65806
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview3
  • Update CODEOWNERS for directory ownership changes #65748
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-preview3

Updated

  • MVC+OpenAPI: Support multiple `Produces` for same status code / content-type #65650
    area-mvc, feature-openapi
  • SupplyParameterFromTempData support for Blazor #65306
    area-blazor
  • Virtualization supports variable-height items #64964
    area-blazor
  • Refactor param binding failure handling in RequestDelegate #64539

  • [wasm][coreCLR] do not use mono internals #65029
    area-blazor, arch-wasm, 11.0-preview1
  • Switch default for useHostedUbuntu to false and use dnceng pool #64842
    area-infrastructure
  • Add QUERY to known HTTP methods in HostingMetrics #63276
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-hosting, 11.0-preview1
  • Replace Newtonsoft.Json with System.Text.Json in dotnet-user-secrets #65686
    area-infrastructure, pending-ci-rerun
  • Fix: Apply Blazor WebAssembly JS Initializer configurations (loadBootResource, environment) before runtime initialization #65696
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Support HTTP QUERY #65714
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
